title: spfx-foundry-deploy config
description: All fields are optional. The deployer infers slug from your package.json 'name' and defaults profile to 'chat-completions'. Drop a deploy.config.json next to your webpart only if you want to commit non-default values or pre-declare serveProperties to be prompted for at deploy time.

slug.description: Stable identifier — keys .deploy-output.json so multiple webparts in one repo can coexist. Defaults to your package.json 'name' field (with @scope/ stripped). Lowercase, alphanumeric + dashes.

profile.description: Provisioning recipe. Currently only 'chat-completions'. Defaults to 'chat-completions'.

namePrefix.description: Drives Azure resource names (rg-<prefix>, <prefix>-ai, <prefix>-proxy, etc.). User can edit at deploy time. Defaults to slug if omitted.

location.description: Default Azure region. User can change at deploy time. Defaults to swedencentral.

model.description: Default model. The deploy form lets the user pick a different one from those available in the chosen region.

name.description: Model family name, e.g. 'gpt-5-mini', 'gpt-4o-mini'. Defaults to gpt-5-mini if available.

requestLimits.description: Per-caller request rate limits enforced by the proxy.

serveProperties.description: Extra properties to merge into the patched serve.json (e.g. 'environmentId' for MCP webparts). Empty-string values mean 'ask me at deploy time' — the deployer prompts for them and writes the answer into serve.json only, leaving the file's empty-string contract intact for next deploy.

defaults.description: DEPRECATED. Earlier configs used this block to override individual resource names; new configs should use namePrefix instead. Still honoured for backwards compat — explicit values here win over namePrefix-derived ones.
